Count the five free-tree topology outcomes using an explicit counting unit

Source: R/free-fusion-groups.R
count_free_topology.Rd

Count the five free-tree topology outcomes using an explicit counting unit

Usage

count_free_topology(free, unit)

Arguments

free

A splitaligner_result from align_branches() in free mode.

unit

Either "primitive" or "coordinate". Primitive accounting weights each shared projection by its number of primitive members. Coordinate accounting counts each shared projection once. Both count each singleton once and retain one structural-absence entry per lost primitive.

Value

A data frame with one row per gene and the selected unit. The five mutually exclusive counts sum to Total. Mapped and NA_topo count displayed and absent singletons. NA_fuse and NA_fuse_topo count displayed and absent shared projections in the selected unit. NA_struct counts lost primitives. Topological presence is independent of branch lengths. Member cells retain their structural NA_fuse label.

See also

free_fusion_groups()

Examples

free <- align_branches("((A,B),C,(D,(E,F)));", "((A,D),B,(E,F));")
count_free_topology(free, "primitive")
#>       gene_id      unit Total Mapped NA_struct NA_fuse NA_topo NA_fuse_topo
#> 1 gene_000001 primitive     9      6         1       0       0            2
count_free_topology(free, "coordinate")
#>       gene_id       unit Total Mapped NA_struct NA_fuse NA_topo NA_fuse_topo
#> 1 gene_000001 coordinate     8      6         1       0       0            1
